series.name: Dragon Ball
series.summary: Goku at 12 first meets Bulma, legend of 7 Dragonballs, whoever gets all seven gets wish granted by Shenron.

series.name: Dragon Ball Z
series.summary: Goku as adult, Saiyan origin. Fighting theme. Characters grow, mature, have children. Former enemies become friends to fight greater evils.

series.name: Dragon Ball GT
series.summary: Grand Tour. Goku, Pan, Trunks travel galaxy searching for universal black star Dragonballs.

series.name: Dragon Ball Kai
series.summary: Remastered Z, adheres more to manga. New dialog by original voice actors, new HD transfer.

series.name: Dragon Ball Super
series.summary: Set after defeat of Majin Buu. Beerus God of Destruction awakens. Super-intense battle shakes universe.

series.name: Dragon Ball DAIMA
series.summary: Goku and company turned small due to conspiracy. Mystery in Demon Realm.

series.name: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
series.summary: Enhanced relaunch with new cuts, redrawn scenes, latest visual effects.

series.name: Super Dragon Ball Heroes
series.summary: Promotional anime for video game. Prison Planet, universe missions.
